instruction: Enable natural scrolling (reverse scroll direction) in Ubuntu's touchpad settings.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling natural scrolling (macOS-style scrolling) for touchpad. The config disables it first (sets to false), and the evaluator checks that the agent enabled it (changed to true). Uses GNOME touchpad peripherals schema.
